subject: PO waiver request & vendor onboarding docs for QuantumCloud
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantumcloud.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-11T09:17:00-08:00
Subject: QuantumCloud onboarding docs + PO question

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the demo last week, appreciate the time. Per our procurement team’s onboarding checklist, I’m attaching our vendor setup form and W-9 so we can get set up in your AP system. A couple quick notes/questions for your side: 

- Our SOW for the initial pilot is $4,200 (one-time) + monthly usage expected to be low.
- QuantumCloud prefers to issue a PO for the SOW; however, the pilot needs to start next week and our finance team asked whether Redwood requires a PO for vendor payments under $5k.

Can you confirm whether a PO is mandatory for this amount or if Redwood can approve a one-time PO waiver for onboarding? If a waiver is possible, what documentation do you need from us?

Attached: vendor_setup_form.docx, quantumcloud_w9.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Turner
Director, Strategic Partnerships
QuantumCloud, Inc.
[Attachment: vendor_setup_form.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
[Attachment: quantumcloud_w9.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantumcloud.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-11T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QuantumCloud onboarding docs + PO question

Hi Alyssa —

Great to hear from you and thanks for sending the docs. We can onboard you quickly once a few items are confirmed. Short answers up front: Redwood’s standard policy is to obtain a PO for any vendor invoice >= $2,500, but we can approve limited one-time waivers for pilot engagements under $5k on a case-by-case basis.

To move fast, please confirm: 1) who should receive the invoice (billing contact & email), and 2) whether the $4,200 SOW will be invoiced in one payment or split.

I’m looping in Lauren (Rev Ops) and Marcus (Sales Ops) to start an internal PO-waiver request — they’ll push it to procurement for approval. If you can sign and return the vendor_setup_form, that will speed things up.

Next steps from our side:
- Lauren/Marcus to submit waiver request to Procurement with the vendor docs attached.
- Procurement to issue a one-time waiver memo or request a PO if needed.

Thanks — we’ll try to keep this same-week.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: vendor_setup_form.docx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T08:34:00-08:00
Subject: FW: QuantumCloud onboarding docs + PO question

Marcus / Karthik —

Forwarding Alyssa’s docs to start the internal flow. Per policy, PO required >= $2.5k; because this is $4.2k we need Procurement sign-off for a waiver. I’ve filled the vendor_setup_form (see attached draft) and noted billing contact as: finance@quantumcloud.ai.

Quick ask to Procurement (Eve): would you consider approving a one-time waiver for onboarding pilots under $5k if we get the signed vendor_setup_form + W-9? If yes, we’ll send the approval memo to the vendor so they can invoice. If not, we’ll ask them to issue a PO and pause kickoff until the PO arrives.

Rationale for waiver: pilot value to Redwood product/ops team is high; fast time-to-start is important to conversion. Risk is low for a single invoice under $5k.

Quoted for context: 
> From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantumcloud.ai>
> Our SOW for the initial pilot is $4,200 (one-time) + monthly usage expected to be low.
> QuantumCloud prefers to issue a PO for the SOW; however, the pilot needs to start next week and our finance team asked whether Redwood requires a PO for vendor payments under $5k.

Thanks — please advise.

Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_setup_form_filled.docx]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantumcloud.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: QuantumCloud onboarding docs + PO question

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the onboarding materials and for flagging the timeline. After reviewing the vendor_setup_form and W-9, Procurement is approving a one-time PO waiver for the QuantumCloud pilot (amount not to exceed $4,500). Conditions: 

1) QuantumCloud must submit an invoice referencing this waiver and include the signed vendor_setup_form.
2) This waiver applies only to the initial pilot (one invoice); any subsequent work or renewals require a PO per Redwood policy.
3) Finance reserves the right to request additional verification on bank details if payment terms exceed Net30.

We’ll attach the formal waiver memo to our internal AP record and you can expect payment once the invoice is processed. Please confirm the billing contact and send the invoice to ap@redwood.com with "QuantumCloud pilot - waiver QCLD-2025-089" in the subject line.

I’m attaching the waiver memo for your records.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: po_waiver_approval.pdf (application/pdf)]
